messages:
incident-bot: Incident 3345556666: Tenant routing alert — potential cross-tenant header rewrite detected. Severity: P1. Paging on-call SRE.

jessica: I'm on it. Which customer?

oncall-tilly: paged. looking...

matt: seeing anomalous Host header in proxy logs for dedicated-pool-14. dest tenant id mismatches actual connection tenant.

jessica: customer reported PII showing up in wrong session? CS Amy, can you confirm affected customer?

customer-success-amy: Veridian Health reported patient IDs from another tenant in logs. They have dedicated VPC + reserved pool.

matt: confirmed in proxy logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z proxy[nginx-proxy-14]: conn_id=1789 tenant=veridian-host header=Host: tenant-bleed.example -> route=tenant-903
```

engineer-chen: hypothesis: header-rewrite rule applied upstream during maintenance; SNI-to-tenant mapping falling back to header causing misroute.

jessica: impact scope? how many requests?

matt: rough numbers: ~320 affected sessions over 18 minutes. no storage writes identified yet, mostly GETs to embeddings endpoint.

oncall-tilly: mitigation options: 1) disable upstream header rewrite, 2) quarantine pool, 3) enable strict tenant verification by matching TLS SNI to tenant metadata and reject mismatches.

eng-runtime-lead-chen: leaning toward immediate strict verification toggle (safe quick change). rolling patch: set `ENFORCE_TENANT_SNI=1` on proxy config for dedicated-pool-14.

jessica: can you push that? will it cause client errors for legitimate traffic?

eng-runtime-lead-chen: small chance for older clients that rely on host header. but Veridian is on modern stack. still, we should shadow first then block.

matt: plan: 1) enable verification in shadow mode for 5m to measure false positives. 2) if 0 false pos, flip to enforce. 3) collect request body samples for forensics (redact) and create incident artifact.

oncall-tilly: doing step 1 now. patch applied as shadow. monitor logs.

incident-bot: Deploy triggered by eng-runtime-lead-chen at 2026-03-15T09:20:10Z. CI job #4567.

matt: seeing mismatch rate drop in routing anomalies stream. 18 -> 2 in last 3m.

jessica: start customer comms: Amy please send templated notice that we're investigating header routing anomaly, no confirmed data exfil at this time.

customer-success-amy: ACK, drafting.

matt: switching to enforce now — flipping at 09:27 UTC.

oncall-tilly: enforcement applied. immediate drop to 0 misroutes.

jessica: good. next steps: 1) gather full request traces (redacted), 2) preserve proxies and KV cache snapshots for 24h, 3) run a routing audit for recent config changes to upstream load balancer.

eng-runtime-lead-chen: capturing snapshots, saving to secure bucket (access=secops-only). runbook step executed.

matt: found config change in ops-deploy on 2026-03-15T08:58 that added `proxy_header_rewrite=true` on staging->prod rollout for pool-14. tagging ops owner @sanjay.

sanjay: that's me. I rolled a templated change intended for internal debug. I didn't think it would affect SNI mapping. apologies — rolling back debug flag immediately.

sanjay: rollback deployed, and I'll open PR to restrict header rewrite to non-production pools.

jessica: triage notes: impact limited to ephemeral GET sessions, no writes identified, number of affected sessions small. Customer comms ready: Amy to send update confirming containment and next steps.

customer-success-amy: sent to Veridian: "We've contained the routing anomaly, enforcement applied, preserving logs, will follow up with full audit." They ask for ETA on audit.

jessica: target ETA 24 hours for initial audit, 72 hours for final report. secops lead @lina to review preserved artifacts.

lina: I'll pull artifacts now and start forensic timeline.

matt: any other customers on pool-14? list: veridian, cairn-labs, beta-saas. I'll check their logs for anomalies; early signal shows no cross-tenant traffic other than Veridian events.

oncall-tilly: handing off to night on-call @noah at 10:00 UTC. I'll leave the incident in "monitoring" with tasks assigned.

noah: taking it. please pager if any reappearance.

jessica: thumbs up. incident severity downgrade to P2 after enforcement and rollback. keeping thread open for audit findings.

incident-bot: Incident updated: state=monitoring, severity=P2, owner=jessica.

lina: initial forensics: small number of sensitive identifiers visible in logs; we've redacted and exported copies to compliance vault. filing to legal.

jessica: thanks everyone. I'll prepare postmortem and action items: restrict header rewrite flags, add verification tests, and mandatory canary on prod flag changes.

sanjay: will follow up with PR and post-deploy checklist update.

customer-success-amy: Veridian acknowledged containment and requested hourly updates for next 6h.

noah: monitoring healthy. closing handoff.

jessica: closing thread for now; will update when postmortem complete. :white_check_mark:
